title: Mini MakeWaves Lengthening + Volumizing Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Curling✓ Vegan✓ Lengthening✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A vegan mascara that visibly volumizes, lengthens, and defines for the most amped-up, natural-looking lashes.

Formulation Type: Volumizing, Lengthening

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Aquaflex® Technology: Conventionally used in haircare styling, this ingredient active works to define curl using memory hold (it memorizes the wave of your lash!) while leaving lashes touchably soft. Proven technology helps keep lashes lifted and curled.
- Castor Oil Blend: To help keep lashes healthy, strong, and conditioned.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use the inner wave of the dual-sided brush to build up volume and the longer bristles to lengthen and define lashes.
Recycling Instructions:
-This tube is made from 78 percent post-consumer recycled resin.
Ingredients+
-Aquaflex® Technology: Conventionally used in haircare styling, this ingredient active works to define curl using memory hold (it memorizes the wave of your lash!) while leaving lashes touchably soft. Proven technology helps keep lashes lifted and curled.
-Castor Oil Blend: To help keep lashes healthy, strong, and conditioned.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cera Carnauba/Cire de carnauba, Glyceryl Stearate, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Synthetic Wax, VP/VA Copolymer, Stearic Acid, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Palmitic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Olea Europaea (Olive) Oil Unsaponifiables, Aminomethyl Propanol, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Polyimide-1, Galactoarabinan, Rhus Succedanea Fruit Wax, Shorea Robusta Resin, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Lecithin, Tocopherol, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Citric Acid, Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Ultramarines (CI 77007).

The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
